implement_BaseStanImplementation: implement a subclass of BaseStanImplementation to define a new Stan probabilistic model
get_code: call get_code on a BaseStanImplementation subclass to retrieve the Stan code for the statistical model
get_pars: call get_pars on a BaseStanImplementation subclass to get the list of parameters needed from inference
format_data_to_stan: call format_data_to_stan on a BaseStanImplementation subclass to convert an xarray Dataset into a Stan-compatible dictionary
extract_data_from_stan: call extract_data_from_stan on a BaseStanImplementation subclass to convert Stan inference results into an xarray Dataset
